You can summon a “NEXT” family “Fugan” from your Hand/Trash, without paying the cost. However, any (When Summoned) effects of Cost 3 or less Spirit can't activate.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can destroy a Spirit you or the opponent controls with one core or less on it. If you control any “Fugan”, instead, you can destroy a Spirit you or the opponent controls with two cores or less on it.

CB26-077.name: My Ice May Be a Little Cold...But Your Crime Has Been Put Completely on Hold!
CB26-077.effect:
[Burst: After an opposing Spirit attacks]
Refresh all your Spirits. For each "NEXT" family Spirit refreshed by this effect, put a core from the Void to your Reserve. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the decktop, and when returned, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "Karina Lyle & Ryan Goldsmith", during this turn, every opposing Spirit can't attack/block.

CB26-081.name: NEXT Power "Barrier"
CB26-081.effect:
This card in the Trash is unaffected by any effects.

[Flash]
During this turn, give a Spirit you control +5000 BP. Also, including being in Soul State/pre-advent condition, if you control any "NEXT" family Contract Spirit, during this turn, your Life can only be reduced by one.

CB26-079.name: NEXT Power "Mimicry"
CB26-079.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, return a "NEXT" family Spirit card in your Trash that was depleted/destroyed when this Burst activates to the Hand. Then, by paying the cost, activate this card's Flash effect.

[Flash]
Either exhaust an opposing Spirit, or return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.

CB26-032.name: ORIGAMI CYCLONE
CB26-032.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ivan"/"ORIGAMI CYCLONE", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Exhaust an opposing Spirit, and put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "ROCK BISON" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

CB26-X04.name: ORIGAMI CYCLONE & ROCK BISON
CB26-X04.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, either summon a Cost 7 or less "NEXT" family card from your Hand without paying the cost, or you can [Contract Advent] it, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP. Also, when only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by comparing BP, or when this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to the Trash.

CB26-033.name: ORIGAMI CYCLONE ［2］
CB26-033.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Ivan"/"ORIGAMI CYCLONE", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per Turn, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "ROCK BISON" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"/"ROCK BISON" attacks, put a core from the Void to that Spirit.

CB26-070.name: Photobombing Professional
CB26-070.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Core Step)
You can draw a card instead of putting a core from the Void to your Reserve.

[LV2]
Once per turn, when your Spirits would leave the Field due to your "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"'s effect, you can reveal a card from the decktop. If that's a Green-only "NEXT" family card, you can summon it without paying the cost. Return any remaining card to the decktop or the deckbottom.

CB26-037.name: ROCK BISON
CB26-037.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Antonio"/"ROCK BISON", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
By discarding your entire Hand (at least one card), draw a card for each card in the opposing Hand.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Heavy exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand an "ORIGAMI CYCLONE" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

CB26-038.name: ROCK BISON ［2］
CB26-038.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Antonio"/"ROCK BISON", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can [Contract Advent] from your Hand an "ORIGAMI CYCLONE" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
All your "ORIGAMI CYCLONE"/"ROCK BISON" gain +3000 BP, and are unaffected by opposing Burst effects.

CB26-016.name: Ryan Goldsmith
CB26-016.effect:

(Can't Stack) When cards are discarded from the opposing deck via the effect of your "GOLDEN RYAN", if there is any Spirit card among them, draw a card, then discard a card from your Hand. If there is any Nexus card, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits. If there are any other cards, destroy an opposing Spirit with the lowest cost.

[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as White.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can [Contract Advent] from your Hand a "FIRE EMBLEM" next to this Spirit, or to any others besides this Spirit, treating your [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV2] (When Blocks/Destroyed)
Once per turn, you can activate this Spirit's (When Summoned) effect. The opponent can't activate Burst effects via this effect.

CB26-075.name: Sternbild

All opposing Spirits with BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's must target attack this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

[During Advent] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be blocked.

Besides via Burst effects, when the opponent summons any Spirits/Braves via an effect, you can immediately activate this set card.

Summon this card without paying the cost. Then, destroy an opposing Spirit with (When Attacks) effect. Spirit/Brave can't remain on the Field with this effect.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)

By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

CB26-056.name: Thomas Taurus

[LV2]

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
